concerns.text: FR-007 and US-2 require re-running the 3D baseline on 'identical environmental conditions' to generate a paired dataset. While T023b executes the baseline, there is no task to explicitly verify that the 3D baseline itself is deterministic (i.e., produces identical results on re-run with the same seed). T060a implements the check, but T060b (Execution) is marked [ ] (Pending). Without executing T060b, the 'paired' assumption is unverified, leaving the statistical comparison potentially invalid.

T058b (Execute Edge Case Sensitivity), T060b (Execute Baseline Consistency), T061b (Execute Bonferroni Verification), T046c (Execute Integrity Check), and T047c (Execute Dataset Assembly) are all marked [ ] (Pending). These tasks are prerequisites for T048 (Final Statistical Report) and the 'loss ceiling' conclusion. The plan assumes these artifacts exist or will be generated, but the execution tasks are not scheduled, creating a blocking state where the project cannot reach SC-001/SC-002.

Spec Edge Cases require handling 'zero depth variance (flat objects)' and measuring success rates for them. T006a/T006b mandate generating a 'subset' of flat objects but do not specify a minimum ratio or statistical power for this subset. T058a/T058b (sensitivity analysis) depend on this subset. If the generated subset is too small (underpowered), the sensitivity analysis cannot 'quantify the irrecoverable information' as required by the spec, violating the edge case requirement.

FR-005 requires a 'paired statistical test' (Wilcoxon or t-test) based on data distribution. T057a implements the Shapiro-Wilk check, but T057b (Execution) is marked [ ] (Pending). T048 (Final Report) depends on T047c (Dataset Assembly), which is also pending. The workflow assumes the statistical methodology is finalized before data generation, risking that the chosen test (McNemar vs. Wilcoxon) is invalid for the actual data distribution, violating the 'methodologically sound' requirement of US-3.

SC-004 requires the experiment to complete within '≤6 hours'. T056 (Budget Compliance Report) and T056c (Execution) are marked [ ] (Pending). There is no task to *simulate* or *estimate* the runtime of the full pipeline (T052b) *before* execution to ensure it fits the budget. This risks a violation of SC-004 where the experiment runs out of time/budget before generating the final report, with no fallback mechanism defined.

T060a is listed as 'Implement Baseline Re-run Consistency Check' but the description references 'T047c (Final Paired Dataset Execution)' as a dependency, which is a circular dependency (T047c depends on T060b). The task description should clarify that the baseline consistency check runs on a *subset* of tasks independently of the full dataset assembly to avoid blocking the pipeline.
